sn35.229:1.1: Samuddo samuddoti bhikkhave assutavā puthujjano bhāsati ||
sn35.229:1.3: mahā eso bhikkhave udakarāsi mahā udakaṇṇavo || || 3-5
sn35.229:1.4: Santi bhikkhave cakkhuviññeyā rūpā iṭṭhā kantā manāpā piyarūpā kāmūpasaṃhitā rajaniyā ||
sn35.229:1.5: ayaṃ vuccati bhikkhave ariyassa vinaye samuddo ti || ||
sn35.229:1.6: Etthāyaṃ sadevako loko samārako sabrahmako sassamaṇabrāhmaṇīpajā sadevamanussā yebhuyyena samunnā tantā kulakajātā guṇaguṇikajātā muñjapabbajabhūtā apāyaṃ duggatiṃ vinipātaṃ saṃsāraṃ nātivattanti || || 6-7
sn35.229:2.1: Santi bhikkhave jivhāviññeyyā rasā || la || 8 Santi bhikkhave manoviññeyyā dhammā iṭṭhā kantā manāpā piyarūpā kāmupasaṃhitā rajanīyā ||
sn35.229:2.2: ayaṃ vuccati bhikkhave ariyassa vinaye samuddo || ||
sn35.229:2.3: Etthāyam sadevako loko samārako sabrahmako sassamaṇabrāhmaṇī pajā sadevamanussā yebhuyyena samunnā tantā kulakajātā guṇaguṇikajātā muñjapabbajabhūtā apāyaṃ duggatiṃ vinipātaṃ saṃsāraṃ nātivattantīti 2
